notes: Everything in this file is an assumption, not a reported figure. Change these to test different views.

market.share_price_note: Approximate AMZN price in fall 2024. Used for market-value WACC weights and to compare against the model's value.

projection.nwc_note: Amazon runs negative working capital (customers pay before suppliers are paid), so growth doesn't tie up cash. Set to 0 to stay conservative.
